description: C^2 splits of 1/r^nu (Section 3.3): the window function w on [-1, 1], an expansion in the fewest even PSWFs psi_0^c, ..., psi_2m^c (c = c_s) that makes the local part twice continuously differentiable at the cutoff, normalized by w(0) = 1.
representation: w(t) = sum_k legendre_coefficients[k] P_k(t), |t| <= 1; pswf_coefficients are the coefficients of psi_0^c, psi_2^c, ... relative to the first. With t = r/r_c, the local part is L_nu(r) = r^-nu R_nu(t) for r < r_c and 0 beyond, R_1(t) = int_t^1 w / int_0^1 w, R_2 = w, R_{nu+2} = R_nu - (t/nu) R_nu'. For nu = 1, chi = w/int_{-1}^1 w is the splitting kernel.
bandwidth: c_s from ESP's rule chi(1) = eps for the psi_0 split, one bandwidth for all nu
truncation_error: relative truncation error (3.5) of the split on the band |xi| <= c_s/r_c, limit of large boxes
